title: Current Holdings — Power Stack Decision Score

methodology.description: The headline score now answers a capital-allocation question: how strong is this setup in the market we actually have? Business quality and company evidence remain company-owned. Regime fit and price confirmation can change the decision score without rewriting the underlying facts. Score and Action are separate: a high-quality company can still be WAIT when price already assumes too much.
methodology.evidenceRule: Verified company filings and primary data can change the score. Corroborated reporting can support it. Creator/research leads are questions to investigate and contribute zero points until independently verified.
methodology.contradictionRule: CONFIRMED = fundamentals and price agree; UNCONFIRMED = fundamentals improve but price is flat; DIVERGING = fundamentals improve while price falls; BREAKING = fundamentals and price deteriorate; PRICE-LED = price rises without matching fundamental improvement.

holdings.name: ExxonMobil
metrics: 1.6286 shares · latest $162.14 Sep 24 · value ~$264.06 · transferred cost basis unavailable
Q2 operating cash flow: $23.6B
Watch: $156–159 support held · $164–166 repair/reclaim · ~$176.4 major breakout
holdings.strength: Exxon is already producing the cash that this market rewards. Tight diesel and refining markets give it another earnings route beyond simply needing crude to rise.
holdings.weakness: The stock can still get expensive if investors price today's energy disruption as permanent. High oil also hurts demand if it lasts too long.
holdings.verdict: HOLD / NO CHASE. I still like XOM as one of the cleaner ways to own the energy problem. I would add only on a better price or another clear step-up in cash generation.

holdings.name: MISC Berhad
metrics: 100 shares · avg RM8.30 · latest RM7.92 Sep 24 · value RM792 · P/L -RM38 (-4.58%)
Q2 revenue ~RM4.79B (+76% YoY); attributable profit ~RM1.15B (+149%)
Watch: RM7.75–7.90 support zone · RM8.00–8.10 first repair · RM8.30 then ~RM8.48 confirmation
holdings.strength: Longer routes and expensive tanker logistics keep ships busy and support rates. MISC also has several maritime businesses rather than relying on one vessel market.
holdings.weakness: The possible Yinson transaction could change how much capital MISC needs. I do not want to call that bullish until we know the funding and structure.
holdings.verdict: HOLD. The shipping backdrop still helps. The next question is simple: does MISC use its balance sheet well if the Yinson deal moves forward?

holdings.name: Hibiscus Petroleum Berhad
metrics: 1,000 shares · avg RM2.10 · latest RM2.30 Sep 24 · value RM2,300 · P/L +RM200 (+9.52%)
FY26 net profit ~RM361M (+207%); record full-year dividend 10 sen/share
Sep 24 was ex-dividend for 2 sen; watch RM2.20 support · RM2.30–2.35 hold/reclaim · ~RM2.46 breakout
holdings.strength: FY26 profit improved sharply and Hibiscus still gives us direct exposure to stronger realised oil prices.
holdings.weakness: The share price weakened even while the earnings story improved. I would respect that disagreement rather than assume the market is wrong.
holdings.verdict: HOLD / NO ADD YET. The company story looks better than the chart. I want price to repair before putting fresh money behind the earnings recovery.

holdings.name: YTL Power International Berhad
metrics: 1,000 shares · avg RM3.83 · latest RM5.80 Sep 24 · value RM5,800 · P/L +RM1,970 (+51.44%)
Seven reserved Siemens SGT-9000HL turbines imply >5.25GW potential generation capacity, but capacity is not the same as funded/energised demand
Watch: RM5.65–5.70 support · ~RM6.02 breakout · ~RM6.14 confirmation
holdings.strength: Malaysia needs more power for data centres and AI infrastructure. YTL Power owns assets that can benefit if that demand becomes contracted, funded load.
holdings.weakness: Building power and data-centre capacity costs a lot of money. The stock has also rerated hard, so a good AI story is no longer enough on its own.
holdings.verdict: HOLD / NO CHASE. I like the physical-power story. I do not want to pay for capacity before customers, funding and cash flow prove how valuable it is.

holdings.name: YTL Power structured warrant / linked instrument
metrics: Rakuten: 200 units · no reliable displayed valuation
Parent-company evidence comes from YTLPOWR; the warrant still needs its own strike, expiry, liquidity and time-decay analysis
Track parent levels: RM5.65–5.70 support · ~RM6.02 breakout · ~RM6.14 confirmation
holdings.strength: The direction still comes mainly from YTL Power, so a stronger parent thesis can help the warrant.
holdings.weakness: Expiry, strike, liquidity and time decay can overwhelm a correct view on YTL Power. We still do not have enough instrument-level evidence.
holdings.verdict: TRACK ONLY. Do not treat the parent-company score as a warrant valuation. Verify the instrument terms before making any fresh decision.

holdings.name: Take-Two Interactive Software
metrics: Q1 FY2027 net bookings: $1.39B; recurrent spend 84% of revenue
Watch: ~$202–203 current floor area · ~$210 first repair · $216–217 confirmation · $228–233 stronger recovery
holdings.strength: Take-Two owns exceptional game franchises and GTA VI can still create a major step-up in bookings and cash flow.
holdings.weakness: The stock has fallen hard even as the GTA VI launch gets closer. That is a real contradiction, especially when high yields make distant cash flows less valuable.
holdings.verdict: HOLD BECAUSE OWNED / NO NEW MONEY YET. GTA VI is still the reason to care. I want the stock to stop making lower lows or the cash-flow evidence to improve before adding.

holdings.name: Tesla
metrics: Tesla has begun Semi deliveries to initial customers, but disclosed pricing/production economics remain insufficient for a score change
Watch: $353–355 support · $375–383 repair/hold zone · ~$397 next confirmation
holdings.strength: Tesla has real optionality in energy storage, autonomy and robotics, and its balance sheet gives it more room than heavily indebted growth companies.
holdings.weakness: The market is being asked to pay today for a lot of future execution while the auto business is under pressure and capex is rising. A 5%+ rate world makes that future more expensive.
holdings.verdict: HOLD / NO ADD. I want the new businesses to start carrying more of the economics before paying a higher price for the promise.

holdings.name: Dayang Enterprise Holdings Berhad
metrics: 400 shares · avg RM1.81 · latest RM1.47 Sep 24 · value RM588 · P/L -RM136 (-18.78%)
Q2 revenue ~RM161M (-40% YoY); attributable profit ~RM32.8M (-57% YoY); order book ~RM4.72B
Watch: RM1.42 critical support · RM1.50–1.52 recovery · ~RM1.57 breakout
holdings.strength: Dayang still has a sizeable order book and can benefit if offshore maintenance work and vessel utilisation recover.
holdings.weakness: Revenue and profit are down, and the share price is near the bottom of its range. Higher oil has not yet turned into better operating results.
holdings.verdict: HOLD / DO NOT AVERAGE DOWN. I need utilisation, work orders and earnings to improve before this deserves fresh capital again.
